course.title: Computer Graphics and Image Processing
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value:
What is the necessity of transforming an image into frequency domain? Let, $\mathrm { F } ( u , 
u )$ is a [M, N] point Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) of an image defined by $f ( x , y )$ . Then show that $ ar { \mathrm { F } ( u , 
u ) } = \mathrm { F } ( u + p \mathrm { M } , 
u + q \mathrm { N } )$ , where $p , q$ are arbitrary constant.
